toh_seite.Comments network ports_: Realtek RTL8221B 2.5GbE PHY -or- Motorcomm YT8821 2.5GbE PHY
toh_seite.Installation method(s)_method-installati: TFTP generic, GUI OEM, see devicepage
toh_seite.Comment installation: Need a signed OpenWrt from cudy before installing official OpenWrt image.  TFTP upload is also possible after OEM firmware version 2.47+
toh_seite.Recovery method(s)_method-recoverys: TFTP generic, see devicepage, see git-commit
toh_seite.Comment recovery: OEM firmware version 2.47+ provides TFPTD function from U-boot.  Recommend to upgrade OEM firmware for TFTP access.  Alternatively, recovery can be achieved via serial console by opening the case.
toh_seite.Comments_: A new variant of AP3000 v1 has been discovered with a different 2.5GbE network PHY chip "Motorcomm YT8821" .  See Device Page for more info.
